about_the_game:
The English translation of this official release has not been completed yet and it will take some time. We will update it as soon as it is completed. Please be patient. Thank you.

      The oddities in traditional MMO online games, the weirdos in the open world~Various bizarre equipment effects, over 100 million build combinations, great secret realm layer racing, PVE/PVP plundering competition, and GVG large city competition. A battle command system where one person works hard and four people enjoy it, allowing hardworking teammates to enjoy themselves. Any gameplay has a ranking, you can roll it to your heart's content, come and roll King Liver Emperor!!!

Game Features:

▷Freely explore the seamless large map, a real open world, where you can collect supplies, challenge wild BOSS/copy, make friends, and team up for adventures.

▷Equipment depends entirely on fighting, and interesting Builds are ever-changing. There are a wealth of equipment, weapons, skills, talents, etc. in the game for players to freely choose and match. A large number of Build gameplays can be combined with each other to create exclusive Build sets and skills that are fun and interesting.

▷A team of four people adventures, one person completes the four people to benefit, and winning by lying is a kind of strength and a kind of enjoyment!

▷PPV/PVE/GVG various gameplays meet all your needs for MMO games! PVP focuses on the ultimate performance of personal skills and operations. PVE is a display of the high degree of team Build and strategic coordination. And GVG is a display of the strength of the war alliance guild. No matter which one, your own strength needs to continue to grow and improve in order to choose strong teammates and guilds.

▷Seasonal gameplay, no game progress, return at any time. The season system will be reset every once in a while, and all players need to compete again for the resources obtained during the season. Players who are unable to participate will not fall behind in the game progress of other players due to lack of time to go online. This is a very considerate way of playing.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Corei5 7500/AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 2G
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti 4G
  • DirectX: Version 12
